name: iphone-use
description: Local fork with checkpointed, paced touch execution and an external trajectory planner. Read and operate a real iPhone over USB or Wi-Fi; repetitive work uses explicit page checks and stops on uncertain outcomes.

interface.shortDescription: Let your agent operate a real iPhone
interface.longDescription: Local codepiano fork of leeguooooo/iphone-use. A native XCTest runner controls the phone over USB or Wi-Fi. Repetitive third-party app tasks use the bundled guarded launcher with page checks, paced single contacts and an external private planner. Uncertain outcomes pause without retry. Install only the verified local fork runtime; upstream binaries do not include this touch_path integration.
defaultPrompt: Check the verified guarded local runtime and phone connection; preserve its fork version and any paused task.
Check that my iPhone is drivable, then open Settings and tell me which iOS version it runs.
